author: Leon Made This / s010s

description.en: Genus-level middle-axis partial fossil relief informed by ROM59925B Figure 5.8; one undivided axis and short unbranched radial whorls, with both ends unresolved. Matrix, crop, depth, repeated counts and enlargement are authored; no base or top completion or whole-organism claim.
description.zh: 依据 ROM59925B 图5.8 的中段化石轴局部浮雕，保留不分叉主轴和短直轮生枝；两端未补全。基质、裁切、深度、重复数量和放大尺度为创作，不宣称完整生物。
